purpose: Coverage and launch-readiness register for files directly addressable under public/media. This register records review work still required; it does not treat existing publication, filenames, social-media use, blur/redaction hints or automated checks as consent or human approval. Mixed field-media groups default to sensitive context; a human reviewer may explicitly set sensitiveContext=false only for an individual asset that contains no beneficiary/patient/minor/private-context material.

groups.notes: Completed assistance derivatives may contain beneficiaries, patients or family context. Redacted/blurred/cropped naming is only a processing hint and is not proof of consent or approval.

Campaign media requires source, visible-person and website-channel review before launch certification. This mixed field-media group defaults to sensitive context; an individual preparation/product-only asset may be explicitly overridden to sensitiveContext=false only after human inspection.

Multi-year field media remains pending individual human privacy, consent and provenance review. This mixed field-media group defaults to sensitive context; an individual preparation/product-only asset may be explicitly overridden to sensitiveContext=false only after human inspection.

Historical relief media remains pending individual website-use review. This mixed field-media group defaults to sensitive context; an individual preparation/product-only asset may be explicitly overridden to sensitiveContext=false only after human inspection.
Financial-assistance outcome media is treated as sensitive until a human reviewer records a decision.

Campaign field and preparation media remains pending individual human review. This mixed field-media group defaults to sensitive context; an individual preparation/product-only asset may be explicitly overridden to sensitiveContext=false only after human inspection.
Education media can involve minors and therefore remains sensitive until individual review is documented.
Winter relief media can include students or beneficiaries and remains pending individual review.

inventorySummary.note: Counts are repository inventory metadata only, not human media approval.
